Historical full-card image of [[Weather Vane (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds) (Remastered 2006)|Weather Vane]], matching the [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

== Source ==
* Package: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/holotable/windows/holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe] (Story #419).
* Distribution member: <code>cards/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/weathervane.gif</code>.
